paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across values.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the macro-F1 scores achieved by MatDetector and ChemDataExtractor across a range of lambda values. The x-axis, labeled “λ value,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 3, with tick labels spaced at increments of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, also follows a linear scale from 70.0% to 75.5%, with tick labels spaced at increments of 0.5%. The magenta line represents MatDetector, beginning at approximately 73.2% at λ = 0 and demonstrating an increasing trend, peaking at approximately 75.3% at λ = 0.8, before declining to approximately 72.8% at λ = 2.9. The olive line represents ChemDataExtractor, beginning at approximately 72.1% at λ = 0, exhibiting a decreasing trend from λ = 0 to λ = 0.3, followed by an increasing trend to approximately 73.4% at λ = 0.7, and then a declining trend to approximately 71.8% at λ = 2.9. The dark teal line represents a combination of the two methods (w/o) and begins at 71.5% at λ=0, increasing to 73.0% at λ=0.3 and continuing to increase to 73.9% at λ=0.7, decreasing to 71.2% at λ = 2.9.
